## Account manager checklist

Tick these before requesting review. The preview link is posted by the Checks workflow.

- [ ] `npm run validate -- --strict` passes locally
- [ ] Every word on the page is the client's own, approved copy
- [ ] Testimonials are real reviews, quoted accurately
- [ ] The offer and its fine print match what the client actually honours
- [ ] Phone number connects to the right line, and the tel: link dials it
- [ ] The form's fields match what the sales team needs, and nothing more
- [ ] Checked at 375px wide as well as on a laptop
- [ ] Images are the client's own or licensed, and compressed
- [ ] GA4 and Google Ads IDs are filled in, with a conversion label

## Landing page lead

- [ ] Preview loads and the layout holds up on a phone
- [ ] Lead form submits and the lead arrives in the destination system
- [ ] Conversion tracking fires on `/thanks`
- [ ] Custom domain is attached in Cloudflare and resolves
